label: main season
summary: E1 is the survey team’s own observation of an object that looked like explosive ordnance, recorded with a photo, and is classified as direct evidence under the project rule. National criteria do not provide technical survey, so the target proceeds to clearance.
flags: For the sign-off reviewer: the team marked the location from a safe distance, reported it, and took a photo.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The survey team saw an object that looked like explosive ordnance on the ground at the stream crossing.
E1.note: The survey team’s own observed and photographed object is direct evidence under the project rule for an object seen by the survey team; it is a target for action.
